name: fg
summary: Brings a job back to the foreground.
description: Shell builtin that puts a job (running in the background or suspended) back in the foreground: it takes control of the terminal again and receives keyboard input, Ctrl+C included. Without an argument, fg acts on the current job (marked + in jobs).

arguments.name: %JOB
arguments.description: Job to resume: %1, %2… (numbers shown by jobs).

examples.explanation: Resumes the current job, for example an editor suspended with Ctrl+Z.
Brings job number 1 back to the foreground.
